newsitem.title: UK: Currency helps LIFFE grains down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Currency helps LIFFE grains down in thin trade.

text.p: LIFFE wheat eased in thin trade, with sterling's strength cited as the main bearish factor, traders said.
"It came off 0.50 stg early on sterling's strength. There was a bit of follow through and then it seemed to stop," one trader said.
Large players had apparently decided to bide their time and watch the market fall, he said.
Others said that Monday's news the EU could be about to end its wheat export campaign early was having a deadening effect on trade.
May was most active, with 146 of the total 420 lots of wheat traded. It last changed hands at 97.85 stg per tonne, 0.65 stg down.
Barley volume was minimal, with just 8 lots of May traded. It was last done 0.50 stg lower at 90.00 stg.
